title: Temporal Cellular Phenotype Engine: Reproducible Single-Cell Tracking and Temporal Phenotype Analysis
description:
Open-source, auditable research prototype for image-derived cell segmentation, deterministic tracking, temporal motion features and confidence-gated descriptive cellular phenotype groups. The strongest internally evaluated CellposeSAM-v2 to tracking workflow used 168 DIC-C2DH-HeLa frames, reporting segmentation F1 0.9354, detection F1 0.9684 and temporal-link F1 0.9808 (not official CTC leaderboard results). Reference-centroid controls are separate. No independent biological phenotype, treatment-effect or organ-on-chip validation is claimed.

Source code and reproduction: github.com/chrishotza/ai4s-life-science-2026. Public narrated video: AI4S V10 demo. Project developed under the public GitHub identity Chris Hotza. Original upstream microscopy datasets and pretrained weights are not redistributed in this software release and remain governed by their own terms.
